title: Why Is Godzilla Minus One Called Minus One?

scenes.narration: Have you ever wondered why the movie is called Godzilla Minus One?
scenes.visual_description: Movie title reveal with dramatic digital push-in on MINUS ONE
Direct cut to postwar ruined Tokyo with smoke rising

scenes.narration: The story takes place in Japan just after World War II.
scenes.visual_description: Postwar Japanese scorched earth setting after surrender

scenes.narration: The war has already left the country devastated.
scenes.visual_description: Panoramic shot of incinerated city ruins
Collapsed concrete structures and charred avenues
Postwar hardship, black market shelters and broken infrastructure

scenes.narration: ...and people are struggling to rebuild their lives.
scenes.visual_description: Civilians clearing rubble and struggling to rebuild

scenes.narration: In other words, Japan is already at zero.
scenes.visual_description: Devastated skyline baseline with bold numerical 0
Hard cut to Godzilla rising from ocean and roaring

scenes.narration: And instead of letting the country recover, he causes even more destruction.
scenes.visual_description: Godzilla rampaging in Ginza, stomping buildings and biting commuter train

scenes.narration: Japan goes from zero to minus one.
scenes.visual_description: Animated transition from 0 to -1 over atomic destruction aftermath

scenes.narration: That's where the title comes from.
scenes.visual_description: Godzilla Minus One title card focusing on MINUS ONE

scenes.narration: Godzilla doesn't just destroy a country.
scenes.visual_description: Atomic breath shockwave and nuclear blast tearing through Tokyo

scenes.narration: He pushes a country that has already lost everything even further into disaster.
scenes.visual_description: Towering Godzilla silhouette roaring over burning ruined city
